items.quote: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
items.claim: Moses and Aaron, commanded by the LORD, lifted a rod and struck the river's waters, causing all the waters to turn to blood
items.action: lifted up the rod, and smote the waters
items.mechanism: striking the waters with a rod causes transformation to blood
